blocks.text:
To answer the arithmetic question for BETA again, I will use the same method as before, the distributive property of multiplication over addition. This property allows us to simplify the multiplication of two numbers by breaking one of the numbers into smaller parts.

In this case, we can rewrite 9 * 8 as 9 * (7 + 1) = 9 * 7 + 9 * 1 = 63 + 9 = 72.
